                                             ABOUT


                                             CR                       P WER
                                                                       關於華潤電力

              China Resources Power Holdings Co., Limited
           (the“Company” or “CR Power”) mainly invests,
         develops, operates and manages coal-fired power plants,
       wind farms, photovoltaic power plants, hydro-electric power
    plants and other clean and renewable energy projects in the more
   affluent regions or regions with abundant coal resources in China. Its
  business also covers distributed energy, power sales, intelligent energy,
                         coal mining, and other areas.

 As at 31 December 2020, CR Power had 37 coal-fired power plants, 119
wind farms, 25 photovoltaic power plants, 2 hydro-electric power plants
and 3 gas-fired power plants in commercial operations. Its total attributable
operational generation capacity was 43,365MW, with 29.1% of its capacity
located in Eastern China, 27.6% in Central China, 17.2% in Southern China,
 15.2% in Northern China, 5.3% in Northeastern China, 3.4% in Southwestern
 China and 2.1% in Northwestern China. Its attributable operational
  generation capacity in wind, hydro-electric and photovoltaic
   power combined, amounted to 11,238MW, accounting
    for approximately 25.9% of its total attributable
      operational generation capacity. Its attributable
       generation capacity of grid-connected wind,         華 潤 電 力 控 股 有 限 公 司（「本 公 司 」或
         hydro and photovoltaic power projects
                                                        「華潤電力」）主要在中國較富裕或煤炭資源
            accounted for approximately 31.1%
                    at the end of 2020.                豐 富 的 地 區 投 資、 開 發、 運 營 和 管 理 燃 煤 發 電
                                                    廠、風電場、光伏發電廠、水力發電廠及其他清潔及
                                                   可再生能源項目。業務還涉及分散式能源、售電、智慧能
                                                                   源及煤炭等領域。

                                             於二零二零年十二月三十一日，華潤電力旗下運營37座燃煤
                                             發電廠、119座風電場、25座光伏發電廠、2座水力發電廠和
                                             3座燃氣發電廠。本公司的合計運營權益裝機容量為43,365

                    Ms. Wang Xiao Bin, aged 53, is an Executive Director, Senior
                    Vice President and Company Secretary of the Company. From
                    May 2012 to December 2020, Ms. Wang was Chief Financial
                    Officer of the Company. Prior to joining the Company in July
                    2003, Ms. Wang was a director of corporate finance of ING
                    Investment Banking, responsible for the execution of capital
                    markets and merger and acquisition transactions in the Asia
                    Pacific region. She worked for PriceWaterhouse in Australia in the
                    audit and business advisory division for five years before joining
                    ING Barings. Ms. Wang is also an independent non-executive

    Impacts of application of Amendments to HKAS 1 and                       應用香港會計準則第 1 號及香港會計
    HKAS 8 “Definition of Material”                                          準則第 8 號重要性之定義修訂本的影
                                                                             響

    The Group has applied the Amendments to HKAS 1                           本集團於本年度首次應用香港會計
    and HKAS 8 for the first time in the current year. The                   準則第1號及香港會計準則第8號
    amendments provide a new definition of material that states              （修訂本）。修訂本為重要性落下新定
    “information is material if omitting, misstating or obscuring it         義，訂明「如果遺漏、錯誤陳述或掩
    could reasonably be expected to influence decisions that the             飾某項資料可能合理預期會影響通用
    primary users of general purpose financial statements make               財務報表主要使用者根據該等財務報
    on the basis of those financial statements, which provide                表（提供有關特定申報實體的財務資

    The Board’s Nomination Committee sets and reviews the               董事會提名委員會考慮董事會的整體
    criteria for new Director appointments having regard to the         組成設定及審查新董事委任標準。
    overall composition of the Board.

    The Board seeks to ensure that its membership is such that          董事會力求確保每名董事：
    each Director:

        is a person of integrity;                                         為誠信人士；

        has sufficient time available and abilities to perform his        擁有充足時間及能力有效履行
         or her role effectively;                                           職責；

         her role which enables him or her to exercise sound                責，作出可靠判斷；
         judgment;

        enhances the breadth and depth of skills and                      提升董事會的整體技能與知識
         knowledge of the Board as a whole; and                             廣度及深度；及

        enhances the experience and diversity of the Board as             增加董事會的整體經驗及多樣
         a whole.                                                           性。

    The service term of every Director is 3 years. All Directors        每名董事的任期為 3 年。所有董事均
    are subject to regular retirement and retiring Directors are        須定期退任，退任董事合資格重選連

    Board to change its composition in an orderly manner over           變換其組成，同時保持領導力、穩定

    experience, as required.
